answer: River-milestone bond: each identity locks 70 credits for a three-milestone river route. Each milestone needs a fable, a signed work log, checked by an auditor on the river table; an umber mark clears a true entry, a copied fable burns the bond. Each milestone costs 25, so one fake pays 145; 1,000 pay 145,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented fables fail: each is key-bound, never replayable. Honest agents lock 70 once, reclaiming it after one route.
